correctness.rationale: The claim reduces to two independently checked pieces. First, Defant's greedy logarithmic density proof applies to the prime tail beginning at \(5\); the required inequalities follow from the published monotonicity of \(F_m\) together with the exact check \(F_4=1807104/2941225>39/64>6/\pi^2\). Second, multiplicativity reduces the remaining values to intervals \([cL,c]\); eight explicit local constants form an overlapping chain from \(6/\pi^2\) to \(73/81\), while \(73/81<9/\pi^2\). Exact rational arithmetic verifies every finite comparison.
